text:
Yes, there are two kinds of back-seat screen for the Model Y. Which one to buy depends mostly on your model year.

## Option 1: Rear touchscreen (2019-2024 Model Y)
These 8.66" Android screens mount on the back of the center console. Most also control rear AC and seat heating, and support wireless CarPlay and Android Auto.

- **Amazon listings:** Prices run about $210 to $330, and you can [browse them here](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen).
  - The best-reviewed listings with a meaningful number of reviews are the 8.66" 4GB+64GB units at $319.99 (3.7 stars, 46 reviews) and $329.99 (3.9 stars, 41 reviews).
  - The Tlyard unit is cheapest at $210.99, but it has only one review and ships Nov 4-13, so I'd be cautious.
- **[TESERY 8.66" screen](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla):** $359 (4.7 stars, 22 reviews), with a 30-day return policy. Reviews are mixed: one buyer reports lag, constant child-lock mode and apps that won't update, while another calls it fine for a kid but a little slow.

All of these are aftermarket, and the reviews suggest you should expect some sluggishness. Choose a seller with an easy return policy.

## Option 2: Projector screen (2025-2026 "Juniper" Model Y)
The [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) costs $119.99 right now on sale.

- It's a passive fabric screen and sunshade that clips into the roof, with no wiring.
- It works for rear-seat, tailgate or sky-roof movies while parked.
- You need to buy a portable projector separately, such as Aurzen's ZIP.
- On 2020-2024 cars it only works in roof mode, and the rear panel doesn't fully cover the window.
- A third-party deal site lists code CJ10 for 10% off ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-tesla-model-y)). It says the code can't be combined with Aurzen's automatic sale prices, so it may not help while the Halloween sale runs.

## What I'd buy
- **2019-2024 Model Y, with a kid or passenger who wants a built-in screen:** One of the Amazon 8.66" 4GB+64GB units at about $320 is the safest pick. Check the listing's year range and the return policy before ordering.
- **2025-2026 Model Y:** Be careful with the rear displays. TESERY lists fitment only through 03/2025, and the Amazon listings say 2019-2024. Confirm fitment with the seller first, or go with the Aurzen screen plus a projector.

What year is your Model Y, and is this mainly for kids? That would let me narrow it down.
